title: 꿈에서도 야근
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and Funk-Pop fusion. Features a slap bass guitar playing syncopated sixteenth-note patterns and a bright, clean electric guitar performing rhythmic scratches and staccato chords. The drum kit uses a crisp snare and a punchy kick drum. Male vocals alternate between rhythmic rapping and melodic singing in a tenor range. Synthesizer accents include bright brass-like stabs and subtle pad swells. The tempo is 115 BPM in the key of E minor.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[slap bass, clean electric guitar scratches, punchy drum beat]

[Verse 1]
[rhythmic male vocals]
새벽 세 시에 눈이 떠졌어

네 알겠습니다 반사적으로 나와

같은 말은 내일까지 해
이게 꿈이야 현실이야 대체
